subject: You have received a Royal Mail return label from SHEIN
body:
Dear Customer, According to your request, a return label has been successfully submitted. Please follow the return guidelines to complete the return process.

Return information

Order number：GSO1WT01Q00NH14 Return ID: UR1387E00MR8

We recommend that you take photos or short videos while packing your return items as proof of return, and keep your drop-off receipt (if any) until you receive a complete refund.
1. Please print the attached return label and adhere it to the outside of the return parcel.
2. Items must be returned in their original package with all of the barcodes attached.
3. This return label may only be used once.

You can choose to:
• Print your return label at home (Please click here to get your return label)
• Print your return label at Royal Mail (Using your phone, kindly show the saved QR code to Royal Mail staff, and they will scan the QR code and print a label for you)

Thank you for choosing SHEIN. Stay gorgeous!
Sincerely,
SHEIN Customer Care Center
